title: Create chip distribution API endpoint
description: Add chip distribution endpoint to kline.py router: GET /api/v1/kline/{code}/chip-distribution that calls DataFetcherManager.get_chip_distribution() and returns ChipDistributionResponse. This endpoint fetches from external API (not database).
implementation: Add import for DataFetcherManager from data_provider.base
Create get_fetcher_manager() dependency function that returns DataFetcherManager instance (follow existing pattern in src/agent/tools/data_tools.py)
Define GET /{code}/chip-distribution endpoint with Path param code:str
Return ChipDistributionResponse constructed from ChipDistribution object fields
Handle exceptions with same error pattern: ValueError->400, Exception->500

reference.pattern: DataFetcherManager singleton with circuit breaker for external API calls
reference.examples: Follow _handle_get_chip_distribution() in data_tools.py for how ChipDistribution is accessed. ChipDistribution fields: code, profit_ratio, avg_cost, cost_90_low/high, concentration_90, cost_70_low/high, concentration_70

criteria: Returns 404 when chip data is unavailable (external API returns None)
Returns 500 with error detail for service failures
DataFetcherManager circuit breaker is respected (no manual timeout handling needed)
